title: mentha × rotundifolia subsp. insularis
intro: Mentha × rotundifolia subsp. insularis, commonly known as Cornish mint, is a hybrid subspecies of mint native to the southwestern coast of England. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its ability to alleviate digestive issues, reduce nausea, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Cornish mint include its analgesic, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, making it a natural remedy for relieving headaches, colds, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Mentha × rotundifolia subsp. insularis include menthone, limonene, and menthol, which contribute to its medicinal properties and fragrance.
